counter.$description: Small numeric pill sitting on top of an already-colored button fill (the icon-left+text+counter-right content variant of both button.primary and button.secondary). A general-purpose standalone counter/badge (for nav items, list rows, etc. on a plain page surface) is deferred until a real use case for it shows up — not built speculatively.

size.$description: Shared by every surface variant below — sizing doesn't depend on which button it sits on, only sm/base/lg does. Not a text-style.* alias — every existing bold text-style (label-sm/base) bakes in uppercase + wide tracking for all-caps words, wrong for digits. Composed directly from typography primitives instead. leading.none (1) rather than normal/tight — a single-line numeric pill centers better with no extra line-box air.

onPrimary.$description: For use on top of an active-colored (fill.active) button/tab. The counter never uses the active/brand colour itself (it sits ON that colour) — active = a white pill with dark text (pops off the bright fill), inactive = a muted grey pill with dark text.

inactive.$description: Seen/zero count — a muted grey pill (secondary grey) with dark text; quiet but still legible on the bright button.

active.$description: Has a meaningful count — a white pill with dark text so it pops off the active fill. Never orange text (which would blend into the button).

onNeutral.$description: For use on top of a neutral (secondary button / tab track) surface. Same treatment as onPrimary — a white pill (active) or muted grey pill (inactive), both with dark text — so the counter reads consistently regardless of which surface it sits on.
